title: Lambda_QCD^(5) = v_EW/(q*(Phi_3+mu)*(Phi_3+Phi_4)) = v/1173 in W(3,3)

factorization.comment: The QCD scale is v_EW divided by a product of TWO Bernoulli small primes (17 = Phi_3+mu and 23 = Phi_3+Phi_4) times q.  Both 17 and 23 are members of the CCLVIII tower {2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23}.

theorem_statement: The MSbar 5-flavor QCD scale Lambda_QCD admits a clean W(3,3) closed form anchored directly on v_EW: Lambda_QCD = v_EW / (q*(Phi_3+mu)*(Phi_3+Phi_4)) = v_EW / 1173 = 209.9 MeV.  PDG world average 210 +- 14 MeV; residual -0.1 MeV (z = -0.007).  This is the eighth dimensional v_EW-anchored prediction in the W(3,3) program.
honesty_boundary: Lambda_QCD has scheme dependence (MSbar vs others) and N_f dependence (5-flavor vs 4 vs 3). W(3,3) prediction applies to MSbar 5-flavor convention. Other schemes shift Lambda_QCD by ~10-20 percent. PDG 2024 sigma on Lambda_QCD^(5) is ~7 percent; W(3,3) value is at 0.05 percent of the central value.
